greeting: Hello! Welcome to the Smart FAQ assistant. I can help with courses, syllabi, admissions, registration, required documents, deadlines, fees, payments, receipts, portal access, contact details, and office hours. What would you like to know?
course_enquiry: Course offerings vary by institution and academic year. Please check the official course catalogue or contact the academic office for the current list of programs, eligibility criteria, and available seats.
syllabus: You can usually find the current syllabus or curriculum on the institution's official website under Academics, Departments, or Curriculum. If it is not listed, contact your department office and specify your program and semester.
admission_process: A typical admission process is: check the official eligibility criteria, complete the application on the official admissions portal, upload the requested documents, pay any applicable application fee, and track your application status. Follow the institution's official instructions because steps and requirements differ.
registration: Use the official student or admissions portal to register. Enter your details carefully, upload any required information, and save the application or registration number. If the portal shows an error, take a screenshot and contact the admissions/helpdesk team. Never share your password or OTP.
admission_documents: Commonly requested documents may include academic marksheets or certificates, proof of identity, a recent photograph, and any applicable transfer or category certificates. The exact list depends on the institution and program, so confirm it in the official admission notice before submitting.
admission_deadline: Admission deadlines change by program and academic year. Please check the latest official admission notification or portal for the closing date. I do not have a verified current deadline, so I don't want to give you an incorrect date.
fees: Tuition and other charges vary by program, year, and student category. Check the official fee structure or current admission notice, and confirm any hostel, examination, or one-time charges with the accounts office before making a payment.
fee_payment: Use only the payment methods listed on the institution's official fee portal or fee notice. After paying, save the transaction/reference number and confirmation. If payment is deducted but the portal still shows unpaid, contact the accounts office with the transaction reference; do not pay again until the status is checked.
fee_receipt: After a successful payment, check the fee portal's Payment History, Transactions, or Receipts section for a downloadable receipt. If it is missing, keep your transaction reference and contact the accounts office to request verification or a duplicate receipt.
technical_login: First check your internet connection and confirm you are using the official student portal and correct login ID. Try refreshing the page or using a supported browser. If the error continues, contact the institution's IT helpdesk and include the exact error message. Never send your password or OTP.
password_reset: Use the official portal's 'Forgot Password' or password recovery option. Check your registered email or phone and spam folder for the reset message. If it does not arrive, contact the IT helpdesk to verify your registered contact details. Never share reset codes, passwords, or OTPs.
technical_issue: Try refreshing the page, checking your internet connection, and using an updated browser. If a form fails, save the error message or screenshot and note the time it occurred. Contact the IT helpdesk if the problem persists; do not submit sensitive information through unofficial channels.
contact_information: For accurate phone numbers, email addresses, and campus directions, use the institution's official website or published admission notice. This demo does not contain verified institution-specific contact details, so I won't invent an email address or phone number.
office_hours: Office hours can vary by department, weekday, holidays, and academic calendar. Check the official website or call the relevant office before visiting. This demo does not have live access to current office timings.
goodbye: You're welcome! Thanks for using the Smart FAQ assistant. Have a great day.
